questions.prompt: Graph f(x) = x² and g(x) = (x - 3)² - 2 on the same grid. Label both, and describe how g is related to f.
questions.prompt_markup: Graph f(x) = x² and g(x) = (x - 3)² - 2 on the same grid. Label both, and describe how g is related to f.
questions.correct_answer: Both parabolas; g has vertex (3, -2): it is f shifted 3 units right and 2 units down

questions.prompt: f(x) = |x|. Graph g(x) = 2f(x) and h(x) = f(2x) for -3 ≤ x ≤ 3, using a table or graphing technology. Are g and h the same function?
questions.prompt_markup: f(x) = |x|. Graph g(x) = 2f(x) and h(x) = f(2x) for -3 ≤ x ≤ 3, using a table or graphing technology. Are g and h the same function?
questions.correct_answer: Yes. |2x| = 2|x| for every x, so g and h have the same graph.
questions.drawing_answer: One V-shape with vertex (0, 0) and slopes 2 and -2 (both g and h)
questions.grading_note: Form required: the answer with a reason or table. Both the graph and the answer are graded.
